gloss: mourning period; period of abstinence after a death

definitions.gloss: mourning period; period of abstinence after a death
definitions.explanation: The period following the death of a close family member during which the bereaved abstain from celebrations, shrine visits, and certain social activities. Traditionally 49 days in Buddhist custom.

examples.japanese: {忌中|きちゅう}のため、{年賀状|ねんがじょう}は{出|だ}しません。
examples.english: We won't be sending New Year's cards because we are in mourning.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{忌中|きちゅう}の{札|ふだ}が{貼|は}ってあった。
examples.english: A mourning notice was posted at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {忌中|きちゅう}は{神社|じんじゃ}への{参拝|さんぱい}を{控|ひか}えるのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is common practice to refrain from visiting shrines during the mourning period.

notes:
A formal term for the mourning period observed after the death of a close relative. In Buddhist tradition, the period typically lasts 49 days ({四十九日|しじゅうくにち}), during which the soul is believed to be in transition. In Shinto custom, the period of ritual impurity is generally shorter.

DURING MOURNING:
- {年賀状|ねんがじょう}を{控|ひか}える: refrain from New Year's cards (send {喪中|もちゅう}はがき instead)
- {神社|じんじゃ}への{参拝|さんぱい}を{避|さ}ける: avoid shrine visits
- {祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}への{参加|さんか}を{控|ひか}える: refrain from celebratory events

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忌中|きちゅう}の{札|ふだ}: mourning placard (posted at the entrance)
- {忌中|きちゅう}につき: due to being in mourning
- {忌中|きちゅう}{期間|きかん}: mourning period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喪中|もちゅう}: in mourning — broader term, typically refers to the full year of mourning
- {服喪|ふくも}: observing mourning — the act of following mourning customs
- {忌明|きあ}け: end of the mourning period
